name: claude-workflow-core
description: Portable Claude Code workflow plugin — 15 shared workflow skills + 3 session-resilience hooks. Bundles git-commit, github-{epic,issue,pr-*}-creation/review/merge, session-start, plus the v0.2.0 set (ack, brainstorm, cr-plan, creating-skills, deep-audit, memory-consolidate, retro, prove-yourself-audit). Domain-agnostic — works in any Claude Code repo.
